notes: Adds SAVE ALL and CLEAR ALL for multi-cover Split Full Cover sessions. SAVE ALL saves every unsaved cover currently loaded, skips covers already saved individually so nothing is duplicated, and clears the whole multi-cover queue after all saves succeed. CLEAR ALL removes the entire current multi-cover queue without saving, with a confirmation prompt. The existing per-cover SAVE buttons remain. Windows validation passed for individual-save-then-Save-All without duplicates, automatic queue clearing after Save All, and Clear All discarding the queue without creating records.
